description: A cooperative boss-fight mode where players deal damage to a shared world boss. Features daily damage milestones, ranking rewards, and selectable buff lists that modify the encounter.

ConfigWorld_boss.description: World boss encounter definitions with multi-stage progression.

ConfigWorld_boss_bufflist.description: Selectable buffs for world boss encounters. Players choose buffs to modify the fight.

skill_id.description: Skill ID applied by this buff (references ConfigSkill)

ConfigWorld_boss_rank.description: Ranking reward tiers based on damage dealt.

reward_rank.description: Rewards for this rank tier [[itemId, count], ...]

ConfigWorld_boss_total_dmg.description: Daily cumulative damage milestone rewards across all players.

day.description: Day number of the world boss event

encounter.description: World boss has multiple stages (indexed phases). Each attempt is time-limited. Players deal damage that contributes to both personal ranking and server-wide total damage milestones.

buff_selection.description: Before each attempt, players can select from World_boss_bufflist. Buffs can target the player (target=0) or the boss (target=1). Each buff applies a skill from ConfigSkill.

rewards.ranking: Players are ranked by total damage dealt. World_boss_rank defines reward tiers by rank ranges.
rewards.milestones: World_boss_total_dmg tracks server-wide cumulative damage per day. When thresholds are reached, all participants receive milestone rewards.
rewards.participation: reward_participate provides base rewards for contributing damage regardless of rank.

boss_damage_modifier.description: In combat, the boss_dam attribute (AttribDefine) provides a damage multiplier when attacking Boss-type units. Formula: if target.type == Boss and boss_dam > 0, damage = roundInt(damage * round(1 + boss_dam)).
